description: Fallback playbook for any topology without a dedicated playbook. Uses only generic shape features so it never crashes on unknown signal sets.

pathologies.explanation: Output overshoots first then rings around the setpoint with multiple zero-crossings — classic underdamped second-order response.
Sustained oscillation in steady state with no decay — limit cycle from saturation, integrator wind-up, or unstable inner loop.
Steady-state value persistently off from target — integrator gain too low, sign error, or feedforward miscalibration.
Settling takes much longer than spec — bandwidth too low or dominant pole too far left.
Output never approaches the target — wiring/sign/scaling error, not tuning.
